Cast to TV.

- New Cast to TV option, in Settings > TV and in the in-game menu (Select + Start). It opens Android's cast picker: pick your Chromecast or Google TV and the picture and sound go to the TV. This works for games and for Music (VLM).
- While casting: TV only (the default) puts the picture on the TV only and darkens the handheld's screen. Your controls and the menu still work on the handheld. Choose Both to see the picture on both screens.
- A TV plugged in with a USB-C to HDMI adapter also works with TV only.
- The game or music keeps running when the picture moves to or from the TV, with no restart.
- Not tested on a Chromecast yet. If the TV shows the picture but the handheld doesn't go dark, your device's casting only offers mirroring; tell me and I'll look into it.
